desc: The Strike Industries Charging Handle for CZ Scorpion EVO (Medium) provides a longer, ergonomic and positive tactile feeling over the original CZ factory charging handle. No more fear of tearing up your knuckles with your fingers being too close to the sides of the top Picatinny rail as you cock the handle. The SI charging handle will ensure more accessibility, even with additional rail accessories like a side mounted weapon light. It's not too big to get in the way and has been designed to reduce the risk of snagging with the rounded edges. Retain the factory ability of being ambidextrous and non-reciprocating. Follow proper CZ instructions on removal and installation to not damage the cocking handle spring and in minutes you will have a quick and easy upgrade for your CZ Scorpion EVO pistol and/or rifle. Made from durable and lightweight polymer reinforced by nylon, the Strike Industries Charging Handle for CZ Scorpion EVO (Medium) will replace that little tiny CZ handle and give you more to work with.
